assumption_ledger.note: Extent of schema drift masked by legacy parser shim is unknown until RN-101 audit completes

dependency_notes.reason: Schema drift must be audited and resolved before fixtures can be correctly backfilled; the legacy shim masks the true schema state
Dashboard summary consumes the step-id schema and must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema to prevent ordering regressions
Runbook and launch checklist depend on knowing the actual rollout and rollback shape, which is only determined after canary proves the summary path

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report with documented differences between expected and actual step-id schema
ordered_steps.summary: Audit and document schema drift in the translator before removing the legacy parser shim. This exposes the true schema state that the shim currently masks.
ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated fixtures in tests/plan_contract.py that validate step-id ordering
ordered_steps.summary: Add dependency-graph fixtures to the plan contract so ordering regressions are caught by tests. Required before dashboard can safely ship.
ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature flag enabled in canary with kill switch available
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch now that schema is stable and fixtures validate ordering.
ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook documenting rollout and rollback procedures
ordered_steps.summary: Update operator runbook and launch checklist once the summary path is proven stable in canary rollout.
ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist

mitigations: Keep dashboard behind kill switch until RN-101 and RN-102 are complete
Add fixture-based contract tests to catch ordering regressions before canary
Validate schema stability in canary before broader rollout
primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect step ordering to users if enabled before schema drift is audited and fixtures are backfilled
